name: Pollen Drift
desc: The air full of what plants send out to find new ground — pappus parachutes riding their separated vortex ring down at a crawl, samaras autorotating into a steady gyroscopic descent, near-weightless pollen advected into visible streamers by the gust fronts, and the occasional spore puff bursting and dispersing on its own slow clock.

density.doc: how much is in the air — a few motes at 0, a full pollen storm at 1

energy.doc: wind strength and gust violence — how far things are carried and how fast they spin

scale.doc: diaspore size — distant haze at 0.3, right up against the lens at 2.4

x.doc: prevailing wind bias — below 0.5 blows left, above blows right

diaspore.doc: which dispersal physics are in the air — all three, parachutes only, autorotating wings only, or just pollen and spores

style.doc: aesthetic — additive backlit photogram (luminous filaments against the scene); a printed botanical plate in ink, blended not added; additive translucent radiograph; soft out-of-focus bokeh with no fine structure

seed.doc: seeds every emission point, fall rate, spin and puff event
